what_the_recorder_must_capture: every depth diff with U/u so queue-ahead at our price is reconstructible
every trade with venue E so a reaching print can be matched to a resting level
book_state and leader identity at the instant of each print
the leading side's own ask depth, which this tape never recorded
MECHANISM_B_resting_maker.why: an 11-point checkpoint grid carries no queue position, no per-level arrival sequence and no trade-by-trade flow, so no fill can be EVIDENCED conservatively. The existing 960-cycle census measured 0.6-1.6% fill with +0.12 adverse move but did NOT condition on leading side or book state, which is exactly the conditioning that matters.
